article.title: Negotiation.
article.content: When a promissory note, bill of exchange or cheque is transferred to any person, so as to constitute that person the holder thereof, the instrument is said to be negotiated.
article.html:
14Negotiation.

Section 14 · Chapter II · page 10 of the Act

When a promissory note, bill of exchange or cheque is transferred to any person, so as to constitute that person the holder thereof, the instrument is said to be negotiated.
